description: This is a React functional component implementing a live-updating time-series chart for vital signs such as heart rate, SpO₂, and blood pressure. It generates mock data points, renders an SVG line chart with axes, grid lines, and controls for pausing/resuming updates, resetting data, and switching signals.

methods.name: nextValue
methods.description: Generates the next data point value with some noise, a bias toward the baseline, and occasional spikes.

methods.name: formatTimeLabel
methods.description: Formats the timestamp into a relative time label for the x-axis.

methods.name: handleReset
methods.description: Clears the current data points to reset the chart.

methods.name: toggleRun
methods.description: Toggles the live data stream on and off.
